title: CROPE: Evaluating In-Context Adaptation of Vision and Language Models to Culture-Specific Concepts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision and Language models (VLMs) on a binary visual question answering benchmark (CROPE) that probes the recognition of culture-specific concepts from geographically diverse regions. The study compares zero-shot performance on these concepts against common concepts and assesses the models' ability to adapt using textual and visual contextual information (e.g., Wikipedia summaries and exemplar images).
